mapper.sql: select e.entry_id, e.entry_type, e.entry_name, e.playbook_id, p.playbook_code, p.playbook_name, e.node_code, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.repeat_yearly, e.status, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark from abr_calendar_entry e left join abr_playbook p on p.playbook_id = e.playbook_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_calendar_entry (entry_type, entry_name, playbook_id, node_code, start_date, end_date, repeat_yearly, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{entryType}, #{entryName}, #{playbookId}, #{nodeCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, coalesce(#{repeatYearly}, 'Y'), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_calendar_entry set entry_type = #{entryType}, entry_name = #{entryName}, playbook_id = #{playbookId}, node_code = #{nodeCode}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, repeat_yearly = coalesce(#{repeatYearly}, 'Y'), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where entry_id = #{entryId}
